fields.label: Location
fields.note: City filter rendered by the listing; the vocabulary is the locations array of /api/jobs (job rows carry 'City, State, India (City_MMT)').

fields.label: Department
fields.note: Department filter, taken from the API's businessUnits buckets and their counts.

fields.label: Employment type
fields.note: Not a portal control; value comes from the collected rows' employee_type.

notes: careers.makemytrip.com/prod/jobs is a React app that performs one GET https://careers.makemytrip.com/api/jobs with no query parameters and receives the complete membership (35 rows, businessUnits summing to 35, 7 location values). The rendered page paginates client-side with LOAD MORE (5 at a time) and its department/location selects and keyword box filter the rows already in memory, so all filtering is local. Details come from /api/jobDetails?jobId=<id>.
evidence: https://careers.makemytrip.com/api/jobs -> 200, allJobs 35, locations [Hyderabad, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore, Cochin, Delhi, Nagpur], businessUnits 9 buckets summing to 35
